positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Building payments and billing infrastructure for Meta's ads platform — from payment retry mechanisms that recovered $1.45M annually to automated tax compliance systems processing 2M+ e-invoices monthly

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Built subscriber growth analytics and a full-stack Messenger campaign builder for Meta Business Suite. Gave businesses visibility into acquisition channels and tools to design, send, and measure rich-media messaging campaigns

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Led a 4-person backend team rebuilding the platform as Go microservices and migrating the database from Firebase to PostgreSQL with zero downtime. Enabled the marketplace to scale from 1K to 5K businesses while cutting API response times by 40%
positions.insights: Skills: Liderazgo · Go · Firebase · Diseño arquitectónico · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: 12-week internship where I contributed to the development of reusable UI components using React Native, enabling product teams to ship high-quality products faster with a consistent user experience.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Developed and optimized key features of the platform's V2 frontend using React and JavaScript, including a multi-step KYC onboarding flow compliant with Mexico's CNBV regulations
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · React.js · Prueba unitaria · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Facebook University Engineering Intern
positions.description:
8-week internship working on mobile app development. Built four different projects utilizing Java, data querying, REST APIs, database caching and Android Studio.

My final project was Feast: an app that aids users in optimally finding restaurants with specified criteria through a user-friendly interface. I used Yelp's API to get info from businesses and Back4App (MongoDB) for backend.

positions.title: Student Ambassador
positions.description: School representative in forums with more than 100 people, leading social projects and marketing events.

honors.title: Premio Nacional Ceneval al Desempeño de Excelencia – Software Engineering
honors.description: National award recognizing top-performing software engineering graduates in Mexico. Awarded to the top 2% of graduates on the EGEL, Mexico's standardized national exit exam for university graduates, taken by over 100,000 students annually across all disciplines.
honors.issuer: Issued by Centro Nacional de Evaluación para la Educación Superior (Ceneval) · Jun 2024

honors.title: Former Rubik's Cube Mexican Record Holder
honors.description:
Set the Mexican national records for single solve (7.48s) and best average (8.32s) in 2016–2017, competing across 9 national tournaments and earning 3 gold, 3 silver, and 2 bronze medals.

World Cube Association Profile: https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/persons/2016GARC14

volunteerExperiences.description: Organized and facilitated robotics workshops in multiple communities across Colima, Mexico, introducing elementary school students to hands-on STEM experiences through LEGO robotics and Bluetooth technology. Over nearly three years, these workshops reached more than 100 students, fostering curiosity, teamwork, and problem-solving skills while broadening access to engaging learning opportunities in science and technology.
